opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 per institution (plus 5% administrative contribution)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that deliver outstanding quality teaching in fine and performing arts; institutions only (no individuals); one application per round.
opportunities.summary: Supports arts training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours (e.g., weekends, evenings, holidays).

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year; maximum total award of £475,000 per institution (plus 5% administrative contribution)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can demonstrate outstanding teaching; university departments are not eligible; one application per round.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate and postgraduate students in the fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 salary contribution in year 1 and £28,000 per year in years 2‑3 (plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK; must hold a doctorate by start date; various career‑break provisions apply.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research over a three‑year fellowship.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease, illness, disability and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who have lived in the UK ≥26 weeks per year and held a UK university teaching/research post at the point of retirement; must be research‑active.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired scholars to complete or integrate a research project and prepare results for publication.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease, illness, disability and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million total; each award funds 18 four‑year doctoral scholarships (UK rates) and 6 four‑year scholarships (international rates) plus additional master‑plus‑PhD places and post‑doctoral opportunities.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two such universities). Applications are made by the lead university; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides large‑scale funding to establish interdisciplinary doctoral scholarship programmes, including support for under‑represented groups and post‑doctoral opportunities.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease, illness, disability and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial); collaborative centres encouraged; one application per lead institution.
opportunities.summary: Supports the establishment of research centres that aim to achieve a step‑change in scholarship across any discipline.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease, illness, disability and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution (starting at junior lecturer scale) plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in the humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers; previous holders are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for two‑ or three‑year fellowships to enable senior scholars to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other UK higher‑education institutions (plus trial independent research institutes). Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative original research projects (up to five years) with a focus on staff costs and associated research expenses.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease, illness, disability and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) who will coordinate the visit; host institution must have research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Enables UK institutions to invite eminent overseas senior professors for 3‑12 months to bring novel expertise and enhance skills of staff and students.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease, illness, disability and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million (staff salaries and associated costs) for 4‑5 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with ≥2 years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK academic appointment (lecturer level) or nominated with a contract offer; must not have previously led a research team or held comparable leadership awards.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career researchers to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership and delivering transformative research.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease, illness, disability and clinical research)
